520:t_2:221.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But now that she has been driven out, we will set up the true Princess of $$ジオン$$.」

520:t_2:222.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Philistine...! Don't speak such vile schemes with $$シャア$$'s face and voice.」

520:t_2:223.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't hand $$オードリー$$ over to you!」

520:t_2:224.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then, $$バナージ$$... as something of equal significance to her, I'll have you tell me the final coordinates of $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

520:t_2:226.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I am told that only you and the Princess know them. If you wish to protect the Princess, you will have to offer a fitting price.」

520:t_2:228.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Nothing can be accomplished without sacrifice. That is the natural order of the world.」

520:t_2:229.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...That is too heavy a burden for that boy.」

520:t_2:231.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(Farewell, $$シャア$$... And $$バナージ$$...)

520:t_2:234.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Is there something you want, $$イノベイド$$?」

520:t_2:235.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If you know about me as well, this will go quickly.」

520:t_2:236.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「This $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ is the legacy of $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$, who believed in the future and entrusted his wishes to the people of later ages...」

520:t_2:237.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And on it, I will not forgive a man like you who denies the future!」

520:t_2:239.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$エルガン・ローディック$$...! Now I will use the function you taught me!」

520:t_2:240.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And I believe in the power of those who will bear the future, the future that $$イオリア$$ and you believed in!」

520:t_2:243.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Restrain them! They're planning something!」

520:t_2:245.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What!? Is the system down!?」

520:t_2:246.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「This code temporarily halts the functions of $$ヴェーダ$$, which manages the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

520:t_2:247.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「But just because the lights went out...!」

520:t_2:248.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「You left yourself wide open, you smug jerk!」

520:t_2:252.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Women and children, gather in the center of the room! Hurry!」

520:t_2:253.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Vice Foreign Minister and Lady $$ミネバ$$, over here!」

520:t_2:256.en:
$$キラ$$
「In a situation like this, we can't afford to hold back!」

520:t_2:257.en:
$$アスラン$$
「I'll take them down in one blow!」

520:t_2:258.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「D-Don't come any closer!」

520:t_2:260.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So you coordinated a counter-operation in advance!」

520:t_2:261.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Impossible! Under surveillance, there's no way they could have done that...!」

520:t_2:263.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But our feelings are one...! That is what makes it teamwork!」

520:t_2:264.en:
$$シャア$$
「You will never understand, $$フル・フロンタル$$! This is the power born of human trust!」

520:t_2:265.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Colonel, escape! I will hold them here!」

520:t_2:266.en:
$$オットー$$
「Lay one finger on my men and I'll wring your neck, boy!!」

520:t_2:268.en:
$$オットー$$
「You're not soldiers! You're nothing but terrorists!」

520:t_2:269.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Everyone, give it all you've got! Don't let a bunch like this do whatever they want with the world!」

520:t_2:272.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It seems we must settle this in the most primitive way.」

520:t_2:273.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Head for the hangar, $$バナージ$$! He means to steal the $$ユニコーン$$!」

520:t_2:279.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$!」

520:t_2:280.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You followed me here, $$バナージ$$. But you would do well not to try anything foolish.」

520:t_2:281.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I can no longer afford to be particular about methods. I'm even considering using every means to extract the final coordinates of $$ラプラスの箱$$ from you.」

520:t_2:282.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't hand the $$ユニコーン$$... or the Box over to you!」

520:t_2:283.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Why do you refuse? If I use the Box, I could change the world.」

520:t_2:284.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Is denying me not a betrayal of the will of your father, who longed for change?」

520:t_2:285.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Only I can use the Box correctly. What can you do? How do you intend to use $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

520:t_2:286.en:
$$バナージ$$
「For everyone... I'll use it for everyone.」

520:t_2:287.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The Federation, $$ジオン$$, space, Earth, none of it matters. For everyone's sake, $$ラプラスの箱$$...!」

520:t_2:288.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「What is this 'everyone' you speak of? No single person can speak for the will of all. Unless one becomes a vessel...」

520:t_2:289.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But only those who have emptied themselves and stepped into a further realm can become vessels. That is no easy thing.」

520:t_2:291.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...But you have talent. If you truly wish to become a vessel, come with me.」

520:t_2:292.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Entrusted with your father's wishes and made to undergo training, you are a kind of enhanced human.」

520:t_2:293.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Having shown that power, you can no longer return to being among 'everyone'. Someday you will run into the same despair I did.」

520:t_2:295.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Keep saying 'even so,' $$バナージ$$!」

520:t_2:297.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Believe in your own strength! It is the light that saved me!」

520:t_2:298.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Enhanced human! I won't let you interfere with the Colonel!」

520:t_2:299.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Pull back your troops, $$フル・フロンタル$$. We will not walk the same path as you.」

520:t_2:301.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A declaration of war from the Princess herself?」

520:t_2:302.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Those who inherit the name of the $$赤い彗星$$... Including myself, there were those who clung to that strength.」

520:t_2:303.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「But you are not $$シャア$$. $$シャア$$ has always believed in the possibilities of people.」

236-237: Tieria's sentence is split across rows; 'And on it' = on the ship
Setsuko's 外務次官 = 'Vice Foreign Minister' (Relena), per earlier slices
